title: Lexus Iraq — LX 2024 Launch
role: Creative Direction, Campaign Concept, Art Direction
summary: Two complementary campaigns for Lexus Iraq — introducing hybrid innovation through a bold visual language and communicating dealership exclusivity through a culturally relevant local message.

blocks.body:
For Lexus Iraq, the creative challenge was to communicate two different propositions to the Iraqi market while maintaining a consistent premium brand presence.

The first campaign focused on hybrid technology, addressing the perception that electrification comes at the expense of performance.

The second introduced an exclusive dealership offer through "يمنا", a familiar Iraqi Arabic expression used to communicate the idea of an offer available only through Lexus Iraq.

Both directions combined clear strategic messaging with distinctive visual execution.

blocks.heading: Hybrid Campaign Concept
blocks.body:
The campaign explored the relationship between advanced automotive technology and environmental responsibility.

A bold visual language was developed around the letter H, creating a recognizable device that could build curiosity during the teaser phase and connect naturally to the hybrid reveal.

Blue represented technology and innovation, while green introduced the environmental dimension of hybrid mobility.

Together, these elements formed a cohesive visual system across the campaign's teaser materials, digital communication, and outdoor applications.

blocks.heading: Teaser Concept
blocks.body:
The teaser phase introduced the H symbol as the central graphic element without immediately revealing the vehicle.

This created a simple visual mystery around the upcoming launch.

As the campaign progressed, the graphic system connected the symbol to the vehicle and its hybrid technology, maintaining continuity between anticipation and reveal.
To showcase the GX model's power and durability, emphasising its suitability for rough roads and off-road adventures.

blocks.title: يمنا
blocks.subtitle: Only by our side — the exclusivity campaign

blocks.body:
The "يمنا" campaign was built around a familiar Iraqi expression meaning "with us."

By using the language of everyday conversation, the campaign communicated dealership exclusivity in a way that felt immediate and locally relevant.

The creative direction translated this message into a premium visual campaign while maintaining Lexus's established brand character.

As Creative Director, I led the conceptual development and art direction, connecting the campaign message with the visual execution across its applications.
